newsitem.title: USA: Fed seen adding reserves via customer or system RP.
newsitem.headline: Fed seen adding reserves via customer or system RP.

text.p: The Federal Reserve is expected to add temporary reserves to the banking system Thursday morning via customer or term system repurchase agreements, economists said.
At 1045 EDT/1445 GMT, the overnight bank lending or federal funds rate was trading at 5-3/16 percent, just below the central bank's 5-1/4-percent target for the rate.
Funds closed at 5-3/16 percent on Wednesday after averaging 5.20 percent.
